title: This best practice document does not work with devtools::test()
description:
The example for "Shiny app defined in a function" does not work correctly when you execute tests using `devtools::test`
Because shinyTest runs in a separate thread, it will use the R libpaths to load the shinytestPackageExample. You will therefore have to Build and Install the package first, before the test can run.

https://github.com/rstudio/shinytestPackageExample/blob/69a1dfe86c4b982832142be7cec42539bb33111c/tests/testthat/apps/helloworld/app.R#L1

Could you comment on a best practice to solve this problem? Either:
1) By installing the package in a temporary location, and starting testApp with this temporary location
2) By using devtools::load_all() in the top of app.R
3) ?
